mechanism: Piroxicam (NSAID) may increase mefloquine levels by inhibiting renal clearance and competing for protein binding, while mefloquine can increase GI irritation and bleeding risk from NSAIDs.
action: Monitor for increased mefloquine toxicity signs (dizziness, neuropsychiatric effects, cardiac arrhythmias) and GI bleeding; consider alternative antimalarial or use lowest effective NSAID dose with gastroprotection.
